subject.title: [Feature]: Add per-agent daily model spend alerts

question: Should OpenClaw add a core per-agent spend-accounting contract now, with informational alerts as its first use, and should it be designed to serve the existing budget-enforcement direction?
rationale: This choice defines a new public configuration surface, durable per-agent state, cost-accuracy semantics, reset behavior, and the relationship between warning-only alerts and possible future enforcement; it cannot be settled safely by a mechanical fix.

options.title: Adopt shared accounting direction
options.body: Sponsor a single core accounting primitive and narrow the linked alert work to the approved alert-only first slice, with a documented future budget seam.

options.title: Keep alerts separate
options.body: Approve a narrowly scoped informational-alert feature whose configuration and state are explicitly not a budget-enforcement contract.

options.title: Defer core support
options.body: Keep the issue open but defer a core configuration surface until maintainers prioritize per-agent budgeting and observability together.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared accounting direction
recommendation.body: Sponsor a single core accounting primitive and narrow the linked alert work to the approved alert-only first slice, with a documented future budget seam.

likelyOwner.reason: Their open budget proposal is the closest existing product discussion for the shared accounting and configuration boundary.
